text:
Anjali Rao: Quick design question about the Compliance > Data retention modal — I'm noticing a few nits around the KMS/region labels and audit-log copy. Can we quick review?

Kevin Lin: yep. which screen? the modal when you edit a retention policy?

Anjali Rao: exactly. current issues I saw: the dropdown says 'Key name' but the tooltip explains region restrictions. Users confuse which region the key lives in. Also the audit log entries read 'Encryption key used' which is ambiguous for cross-region keys.

Maria Gomez: UI nit — can we change label to 'Encryption key (KMS)' and add a secondary hint under it like 'Key region: us-west-2'? keeps it explicit and scannable.

Samir Patel: Agree. Also accessibility: the gray hint text is below AA contrast at small sizes. We should either increase contrast or use a larger font. I flagged it in the spec.

DesignBot: Screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/retention-modal-1769904321.png 
Contrast check: hint (#6b6f73 on white) fails WCAG 2.1 AA for 12px. Suggested: #4a4f53 or 13px.

Kevin Lin: For the dropdown itself, behavior-wise: if a user picks a key from another region, we should surface an inline warning: 'Selected key is in eu-central-1; cross-region encryption may increase latency.' small inline copy, subtle yellow bg.

Anjali Rao: Good call. For audit logs, proposed diff:
```
- RetentionPolicyUpdated by alice — Encryption key used: key-123
+ RetentionPolicyUpdated by alice — Encryption key (KMS, eu-central-1): key-123
```
That way it's explicit in logs for debugging. Thoughts on length?

Compliance QA: prefer explicit. Logs are parsed by SRE; having region in parens is easiest for downstream tooling. Make sure we keep the machine-readable field unchanged (kept as metadata) and only change the human-facing message.

Maria Gomez: On the modal copy I suggest microcopy under the selector: 'Choose a customer-managed KMS key. Cross-region keys are allowed but may affect performance.' Keep it one sentence, no periods in the hint? I'd keep period for clarity.

Samir Patel: Accessibility nit for the selector control: add aria-label 'Encryption key, opens list' and ensure the hint is referenced with aria-describedby. Also keyboard focus outline is currently 2px #e0e0e0 which is barely visible — should be 3px and theme-aware.

Anjali Rao: Thanks — proposed text bundle for copy team: [Modal label] Encryption key (KMS)
[Hint] Choose a customer-managed KMS key. Cross-region keys may increase latency.
[Audit log] Encryption key (KMS, <region>): <key-id>

Kevin Lin: LGTM. Small ask for i18n: avoid parentheses in the label if translators complain; maybe use comma format in certain locales. I'll tag intl.

DesignBot: Accessibility checklist added to the PR: https://git.redwood/retention-modal/pr/1123/checks 

Anjali Rao: Great — I'll update the Figma and push the copy changes to the PR. Tagging @Compliance QA for final sign-off once PR is updated. :thumbsup:

Compliance QA: will verify audit log examples and make sure retention-eval jobs parse the new strings. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
